_comment: Phase 1 renamed theme variables from component-named to role-named. This
is the record of that migration and the evidence for its gate: every old
variable maps to the new one that carries its value, so the token-values
test can prove nothing changed value across a 336-site rename.
'renamed' is a pure rename. 'retired' means the variable was pure
indirection -- it always equalled another token -- so consumers now name
that token directly and the variable is gone.
The 38 names not listed here were already role-shaped and are unchanged.

The eight --location-type-* entries are a different kind of retirement from the rest: they were aliases of primary/secondary/accent/status, and their values deliberately change to palette hues. They are listed under retired for the manifest, and under revalued so the gate pins their new values.
_revalued_comment: Values deliberately changed after the baseline was taken. Listed per theme,
with the old and new value, so the gate still pins them -- a token here is
asserted to hold its NEW value, not merely exempted from the check. Adding
an entry requires a drift-log decision saying why.

--header-bg.why: the chrome becomes one deep near-neutral band (D22)

--footer-bg.why: the footer is the same band as the header (D22)
